title: The Mystery of the Sunny Stone
intro: This quiz follows the story of a lizard on a sunny stone and how warm-blooded and cold-blooded animals stay active.

questions.prompt: Why was the lizard sitting still on the stone?
choices: It was waiting to get warmer.
It was hiding from the rabbit.
questions.explanation: The lizard was sitting still on the stone because it was waiting to get warmer.

questions.prompt: Which animal in the story is a mammal?
What helps warm-blooded animals stay active on cold days?
choices: They make heat inside their bodies.
questions.explanation: Warm-blooded animals stay active on cold days because they make heat inside their bodies.

questions.prompt: Where do cold-blooded animals get most of their heat?
choices: From the air and sunlight around them.
questions.explanation: Cold-blooded animals get most of their heat from the air and sunlight around them.

questions.prompt: What happened when the sun shined on the lizard?
choices: It warmed up and ran away.
questions.explanation: When the sun shined on the lizard, it warmed up and ran away.
